title: Get medical help right away
intro: Day or night, do not wait, if you have any of these:
signs: A severe headache, or one that will not go away or keeps getting worse.
Fainting, gaps in your memory, or dizziness that lasts or keeps coming back.
Changes in your vision: blurring, flashing lights, blind spots or seeing double.
A temperature of 100.4°F (38°C) or higher.
Sudden or severe swelling of your face, lips, hands, legs or feet.
Thoughts about harming yourself or your baby, or scary thoughts you cannot stop.
Trouble breathing, or feeling short of breath, including when lying flat.
Chest pain, or a fast, pounding or uneven heartbeat.
Severe sickness: you cannot keep fluids down, or cannot drink for over 8 hours.
Severe belly pain that does not go away, or pain below your ribs.
Severe pain in your chest, shoulder or back.
Any other pain that worries you.
Your baby is moving less, has stopped moving, or the pattern has changed.
Any bleeding from your vagina while pregnant, even light spotting.
Fluid leaking from your vagina, or discharge that smells bad.
After birth: soaking a pad within an hour, or clots bigger than an egg.
Swelling, redness, pain or warmth in one leg or one arm.
Overwhelming tiredness: suddenly very tired and weak, too tired to get through the day.
Very itchy skin, itchy hands or feet, or itching that is worse at night.
Heartburn that does not go away with heartburn medicines.
Feeling very unwell.
action: Call your doctor, midwife or hospital. If you cannot reach them, call emergency services.
